name: Chatrio
description: Chatrio pairs two online users in real time for anonymous 1-on-1 text or video chat, plus proximity-based local chat (Circles) and an account-based blind-dating chat (Blind Date).

capabilities.name: Random text chat
capabilities.input: optional interest tags (e.g. gaming, music, travel)
capabilities.output: live 1-on-1 real-time text conversation with a random human, not an AI

capabilities.name: Random video chat
capabilities.output: live 1-on-1 real-time video call with a random human, not an AI

capabilities.name: Circles (local/nearby chat)
capabilities.input: approximate device location, nickname, one intro message
capabilities.output: anonymous chat or group room with people in the same approximate area

capabilities.name: Blind Date
capabilities.output: 1-on-1 blind-dating chat (text or video) without seeing a profile first

dataRetention: Random-chat and video-chat messages are not stored; delivered in real time only.
